data.body:
Hi,

I’m Yifan from the founding team at OpenClacky. We came through MiraclePlus, founded by the former YC China team.

Most AI agents are shipped as finished products. The company decides their tools, interface, and workflow, and users adapt to those choices.

We think an agent should work the other way around.

OpenClacky is an open-source, local-first AI agent built around a stable core and an extensible software layer.

The core handles models, files, sessions, tools, context, and permissions. Everything that makes the product yours can live in extensions: Skills, specialized Agents, UI panels, APIs, channels, hooks, and even changes to runtime behavior.

You do not need to know which component to build. Describe what you want in plain language—an Obsidian-style knowledge workspace, a research system, a content studio, or a multi-agent team—and the Extension Developer Agent can plan, build, verify, and load it into your existing OpenClacky.

Your files, sessions, and context stay where they are. The Agent simply grows the software you need around them.

A workflow can start as a Skill. As it gets used, it can grow its own interface, data, identity, and backend, eventually becoming software that others can install, modify, and adapt.

That is the ecosystem we are building: developers contribute integrations, domain experts contribute proven methods, users contribute real problems, and the Agent helps turn all three into working products.

Our job is not to decide what OpenClacky should become for everyone. Our job is to keep the core reliable and extensible, while the people who actually use it decide what it grows into.

Underneath, OpenClacky remains MIT-licensed, local-first, model-flexible, and intentionally lean. Prompt caching, context compression, and a small core make long-running, evolving Agents practical—but they are the foundation, not the destination.

Website: https://www.openclacky.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/clacky-ai/openclacky

If there is a workflow you repeat, a part of your current Agent that feels limiting, or a piece of software you wish it could become, we would love to see you build it with us.

Best,
Yifan

data.body:
Ikalus1988 你好，

我在 GitHub 上看到你在 MisakaNet 上的工作，尤其是 mcp 相关的实践，
和我们正在做的事高度契合，想和你简单聊聊。

我们是和利时科技集团，国内工业自动化解决方案头部企业，正在北京、西安组建
「智能体运行时团队」，技术负责人直接带教，适合想往底层 Agent 工程方向深耕的人。

岗位：智能体开发工程师（北京/西安，3 人，接受应届）

你将负责：
- LangGraph/LangChain 主链编排：意图理解、模型调用编排、结果写回闭环
- Blackboard 共享工作记忆：多步骤中间结果的结构化存储与读写权限
- Harness 五层护栏：指令注入 / 状态机 / 权限范围 / 输出校验 / 会话生命周期
- MCP 工具集成、SSE/WebSocket 流式通信、可回溯 trace

我们希望你：
- 熟练 LangChain/LangGraph，做过项目级设计（不是只跑示例）
- 掌握 function calling / 结构化输出 / 上下文窗口管理
- 熟练 asyncio + FastAPI，具备持久化与 API 集成能力
- 加分：DPO/RLHF、LLM-as-a-Judge、工业/制造/能源业务经验

如果你近期有看机会的想法，欢迎把简历发送至 ghrtraining@hollysys.com；
即使暂时没有，也期待能认识一下，以后说不定有合作机会。

期待回复。
